purpose: Prevent Medicare Advantage claim-security certification from beginning after enrollment and thereby hiding marketing steering, broker/TPMO/HCP incentives, complaint/correction failure, and Medigap exit lock-in.

row_contract.grain: one beneficiary-plan enrollment event joined to a later contract/PBP/service-request/payment/remedy/exit-rights row
row_contract.certifying_row_must_show: The beneficiary was not merely enrolled and later denied care; the row must show whether financial incentives shaped plan selection, whether the plan was suitable to known needs, whether complaint/correction remedies worked, and whether the beneficiary could exit to Traditional Medicare with Medigap protection after serious illness or claim failure.

false_pass_blocks: No enrollment-neutral pass: the MA row must preserve how the beneficiary entered the plan and who was paid or otherwise incentivized.
No broker-disclosure pass: commission disclosure or capped compensation does not prove neutral plan selection.
No compensation-cap pass: a compensation rule cannot substitute for row-level proof that financial incentives did not distort plan presentation.
No complaint-only pass: a complaint or CTM entry must be joined to correction, coverage, restoration, and exit outcomes.
No Medigap-exit pass: exit feasibility requires guaranteed-issue status, underwriting barrier, premium feasibility, and timing, not just the theoretical option to switch.
No DOJ-allegation pass: DOJ allegations create contradiction-risk evidence but not final proof for a specific row.
No OIG-work-plan pass: an active work-plan item identifies unresolved risk and cannot certify a current case.
No marketing-compliance pass: plan/broker compliance documentation must be joined to beneficiary need, plan universe, and post-enrollment claim outcomes.
No plan-universe pass: a list of available plans does not prove which plans were actually presented or withheld.
No independent-review pass: plan selection and exit rights require independent review or adjudication where allegations or complaints are material.
what_this_revision_does_not_prove: It does not prove that a named plan, broker, or TPMO steered a specific beneficiary.
It does not adjudicate DOJ allegations.
It does not prove all marketing complaints are valid or invalid.
It does not prove a beneficiary can actually buy affordable Medigap coverage after leaving MA.
It does not certify any current Social Security/Medicare case.
next_decisive_evidence: Actual broker/agent NPN and compensation data for the enrollment event.
Plan universe presented to the beneficiary and plans withheld or ranked down.
CMS CTM or complaint/correction records tied to the enrollment.
Medigap guaranteed-issue, underwriting, and premium feasibility for the beneficiary state/time.
audit_guardrail: A row cannot certify if enrollment provenance and exit rights are blank while denial/remedy/payment fields are filled.
